title: Repair broken quiz question data files to unblock deployment and AAB packaging

requirements.text: Repair any malformed or truncated quiz question data modules so the frontend bundler can compile successfully. Specifically verify that these files are valid JavaScript modules that fully parse and export a default array: frontend/src/data/questions.js, frontend/src/data/questions_class7.js, frontend/src/data/questions_class8.js, frontend/src/data/questions_class9.js, frontend/src/data/questions_class10.js.
acceptanceCriteria: Running the frontend build succeeds without syntax/module-parse errors from any questions_*.js file.
Each questions data file ends with a complete, syntactically valid `export default [...]` (no unterminated strings/objects/arrays).
The app can navigate through quiz level selection and start a quiz for Class 6–10 without crashing at import time.

requirements.text: Add a pre-build questions integrity check that imports all question datasets (Class 6–10) and runs the existing validation logic (frontend/src/quiz/validateQuestions.ts) to produce a clear, English error message and a non-zero exit code if any dataset is invalid.
acceptanceCriteria: A single command/script can be run locally (and in CI/build environments) to validate all question files and fail fast with an actionable error indicating which class level failed.

If a questions file has the wrong shape (e.g., missing question/options/correct answer fields) the validator reports the first offending question with context (level + question number) using the existing validation behavior.
If a questions file cannot be imported due to syntax errors, the check fails and prints which file/level could not be loaded.

requirements.text: Update the Android release AAB build workflow script (frontend/scripts/build-release-aab.sh) to run the questions integrity check before initializing Bubblewrap / building the AAB, and stop with a clear error if validation fails.
acceptanceCriteria: When the questions integrity check fails, build-release-aab.sh exits before `bubblewrap init`/`bubblewrap build` and prints an English error describing that question data must be fixed first.
When the questions integrity check passes, the script proceeds as before and can produce an AAB (assuming external prerequisites like Java/Android SDK/keystore are correct).

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead).
Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
Keep all backend logic in the existing single Motoko actor (no new backend services).
nonGoals: Adding new quiz questions/content beyond repairing malformed/truncated data required to compile.
Changing authentication behavior or Internet Identity integration.
